svg.title: Statistical test selection flowchart
svg.desc: A decision flowchart guiding users from data type and assumptions to the correct statistical test, covering parametric, non-parametric, regression, and categorical tests.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is the first thing I should check before choosing a statistical test?')
sendPrompt('What are the parametric assumptions I need to check before running a t-test or ANOVA?')
sendPrompt('When do I use a t-test versus ANOVA?')
sendPrompt('What is the difference between a related and unrelated t-test?')
sendPrompt('How does a paired t-test work and when do I use it?')
sendPrompt('How does an independent samples t-test work?')
sendPrompt('What does homogeneity of variance mean and how do I test it with Levenes test?')
sendPrompt('How do I decide between ANOVA, repeated measures ANOVA, Welch ANOVA and MANOVA?')
sendPrompt('How does one-way ANOVA work and when should I follow up with post-hoc tests?')
sendPrompt('When do I use Welch ANOVA instead of standard ANOVA?')
sendPrompt('What is repeated measures ANOVA and when do I need a sphericity correction?')
sendPrompt('What is MANOVA and when should I use it instead of ANOVA?')
sendPrompt('What non-parametric tests are available as alternatives to t-tests and ANOVA?')
sendPrompt('How does the Mann-Whitney U test work?')
sendPrompt('How does the Wilcoxon signed-rank test work?')
sendPrompt('How does the Kruskal-Wallis test work and when does it replace ANOVA?')
sendPrompt('How does the Friedman test work?')
sendPrompt('How do I choose between linear regression, multiple regression, logistic regression and GLM?')
sendPrompt('When do I use simple versus multiple linear regression?')
sendPrompt('Walk me through how to run and interpret a simple linear regression')
sendPrompt('How do I handle multicollinearity in multiple regression, and when should I use PCA or FA instead?')
sendPrompt('What is the GLM and how does it extend linear regression to binary or count outcomes?')
sendPrompt('How does logistic regression work and how do I interpret the coefficients?')
sendPrompt('When would I use Poisson regression instead of linear regression?')
sendPrompt('When should I use PCA versus Factor Analysis to handle multicollinearity?')
sendPrompt('What is the difference between testing association for categorical versus continuous variables?')
sendPrompt('When do I use a chi-square test of independence versus a chi-square goodness of fit?')
sendPrompt('How does chi-square work and what are its assumptions?')
sendPrompt('When should I use Fishers exact test instead of chi-square?')
sendPrompt('When do I use Pearsons r versus Spearmans rho for correlation?')
sendPrompt('How do I calculate and interpret Pearsons r?')
sendPrompt('How does Spearmans rank correlation work?')
sendPrompt('Why do multiple comparisons inflate Type I error and what corrections should I use?')
sendPrompt('Walk me through the full hypothesis testing procedure: H0, H1, alpha, p-value, power')
g.text: All tests share the same logic
H₀/H₁ · α · p-value · power · effect size

g.onclick: sendPrompt('When would I prefer a Bayesian approach over frequentist hypothesis testing?')

svg.text: Click any box to ask a follow-up question →
